result.brief: 提出在冻结扩散语言模型特征空间中最小化 MMD 的后训练方法，支持离散策略梯度与连续潜变量直接微分，提升生成困惑度与解码并行度。
result.reason: Post-training diffusion language models via representation-space MMD in frozen DLM feature space; continuous latent differentiation and discrete policy gradients directly serve continuous language modeling.
